name: gale-website
description: Gale's fleet website -- build step. Source stays plain ES modules with no framework; esbuild only bundles/minifies/code-splits them for production. render-test.mjs keeps testing the source files directly, not the bundle.

scripts.check:browser: node tools/browser_checks.mjs csp && node tools/browser_checks.mjs budget && node tools/browser_checks.mjs phone && node tools/browser_checks.mjs webgl && node tools/browser_checks.mjs visual
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && SKIP_AUDIT=1 bash smoke.sh
